envelope.definition: per family and per r in {0.05, 0.2, 0.5}: err = |guess - spec| at the blocked plane pooled over seeds and committed cells (exp186's Z3 pool formula); the signed price is delta = err_DEEP - err_PROD. Branch (pre-named, evaluated once on the TRUNK/DEEP deltas): INVERTED iff any delta > 0 at any r; else REGIME-FEATURE iff |delta| strictly decreases as r grows for BOTH families (help at deep blockade, vanishing as blockade lifts); else PERSISTENT (every delta <= 0 — the help holds across the envelope — without strict monotone shrink). All three branches complete the gate
envelope.units: mV (|guess - spec| at the blocked plane)
